texts.zh: 岩居兽一直存在于我们的[invaded_system.GetName]星系，使我们严重违反了星系法中关于岩居兽灭绝决议的内容。这导致[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]允许成员投票对[Root.GetName]实施制裁。
texts.en: The continued Cutholoid presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant Breach of Galactic Law under the Cutholoid Eradication resolution. This has resulted in [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] allowing members to vote for sanctions to be imposed on [Root.GetName].
